name: Ashley Rose
source:
Olivia and Don's youngest daughter, Ashley, is a dedicated and talented gymnast. Her room is crammed with all kinds of competition trophies, but it's never enough for Don and he puts a terrible pressure on her to make sure Ashley never lowers the bar and continues to train hard.

Season 2
[spoiler] Tired of having no control over her own life, Ashley ran away from her parents' tyranny but got into a trap set by some monster. I came to rescue her from the devourer and reveal that I was a wizard. Now, to keep her from telling everyone, I had to take her to Dale. Ashley is resentful of Samantha and her parents and won't talk to them. [/spoiler]
